implementation: CppAuditOptions.projection_slots selects one or two invocation-local mutex stripes. Locks span AST parsing, visiting and destruction. Compiler workers, bounded pipe backpressure, ordered census merge, source/header snapshots, final dependency-graph rediscovery and exception propagation remain intact. No persistent cache.
interface: schgen board --audit-projections 1|2. Default remains one for lower memory use. Reject invalid, duplicate and non-board CLI uses; API rejects projection counts exceeding worker capacity.

paired_full_manifest.scope: Single sequential paired experiment with identical compiler/manifest/inputs and no competing test or build processes launched by this agent. Sampled process-tree memory may miss instantaneous peaks. This is an audit-only observation, not a confidence interval, whole-build speedup or Python comparison.
